llm_run.why_this_model: This Mac has 8 GB of RAM. The team plan uses llama3.2:3b-instruct below 16 GB (llama3.1:8b and qwen2.5:7b would be compared only with 16 GB or more).

lead_time.definition: Hours from the first hourly batch that flagged the patient (at least the staff response delay after triage) to the admit decision, true positives only.

fairness_case_mix.definition: Among true admissions in the test quarter, each payer group's miss rate under the deployed policy versus the rate expected if its patients were missed like everyone with the same triage level (ESI) and age band. Unexplained points = observed minus expected.

lead_time.definition: true_positive_rounds: Rounds rows flagged (chance at or above the list threshold) and followed by a departure within 24 hours. Lead = hours from that 07:00 rounds to departure. missed_positive_rounds: Rounds rows not flagged but followed by a departure within 24 hours. Hours from that rounds to departure = warning time the list did not give. eligible_positive_stays: Stays that left before the end of the test window and had at least one rounds row within 24 hours of leaving. Flagged in time = at least one of those rows was flagged; missed = none was. all_flags_diagnostic: Stays that left before the end of the test window and were flagged at least once. Hours from the first flag at any rounds to departure; can exceed 24 hours.
